# Unexplored territory · S08

Editable needs × mechanisms matrix. Drag ideas between cells or use Move; inspect empty/crowded combinations, record why a gap may be overlooked or intentionally empty, and create a candidate in it. Ideas retain mechanisms, assumptions and tests. Renaming axes preserves coordinates and gap reasoning. Unplaced ideas remain available; shared assumptions can be read together. Local workspace preservation, Undo and Markdown/JSON via creative-kit. Limits: 6 axes per dimension, 30 ideas. Counts show coverage, never desirability or opportunity quality. Tests cover coordinate/idea preservation and gap-to-idea transitions.

Combined into Possibility mixer on 2 October 2026. This earlier route and its original storage remain accessible. Mixer copies local Territory workspaces or JSON exports into its shared collection; it retains all writing, partial placements, gap notes and an unchanged original source record.
